description: The centerpiece card of the budget tab. The ONLY floating card on the screen (glassFloating). Summarizes the active scope's budget: Budgeted / Spent / Remaining, a status badge (On track / Watch / Over), and a full-width progress bar. Evolves the current heroCard.

type.description: Active scope; drives label and badge word

usedPercent.description: spent/budgeted*100, not clamped for the label

statusModel.note: Same status color drives the badge, the progress bar fill, and the Spent stat color. Icon + word + color together — never color alone.

stats.label: typography.caption colors.textMuted
stats.remainingColor: colors.success when >=0; else colors.error with '-' prefix, column relabeled 'Over by'

accessibility.label: {type} budget, {status word}, {pct} percent used. Budgeted {budgeted}, spent {spent}, remaining {remaining}.
accessibility.note: Status conveyed by icon + word + color. Progress color is never the only signal — stat text always states the numbers.

developerNotes: Only card that uses glassFloating on this screen (mirrors the dashboard headline rule). Do not clamp the percent label (>100% is truthful); clamp only the bar width to 0..100.
